home.heading: Who am I?
home.intro: A frontend developer who believes code should be as beautiful as it is functional.

journey.title: My Journey
journey.content: My journey into development started in January 2025, when I laid the first foundations in HTML and CSS. I quickly realized I loved creating things that people can see and use. Over the next three months, I intensively studied JavaScript to understand the logic under the hood. In June 2025, I jumped into the React ecosystem, fascinated by its component-based structure. From simple state with useState and useEffect, I gradually progressed to advanced data management with Zustand and efficient async fetching with TanStack Query. My journey is about constantly finding better ways to write clean code.

motivation.title: Motivation
motivation.content: I am driven by that moment when complex lines of code transform into a smooth user experience. I am fascinated by the dynamic nature of the frontend world — what was a novelty yesterday is today's standard. My motivation comes from the desire to be part of a team where I can solve real problems and constantly raise the bar of my technical skills.

vision.title: Vision
vision.content: My goal is to become a versatile full-stack developer. Currently, I am focused on connecting React with a modern backend via Next.js and Prisma, while emphasizing type safety with TypeScript. In the near future, I plan to deepen my knowledge of web optimization and scalable application architecture.

hobby.title: Hobbies
hobby.content: When I'm not debugging the console or styling components, I enjoy sports, family time, and fitness. I believe in a healthy balance between screen time and active movement.
